description: An empty tuple attribute doesn't change another attribute's list type when objects unify
notes: The input needs a null list whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type (ld), which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. hashicorp/hcl unifies objects with different attribute names to a map whose element type unifies all the attribute types (unifyObjectTypesToMap in cty/convert/unify.go). For a list of strings, a list of the dynamic pseudo-type and an empty tuple, unifyTuplesAsList fails because the empty tuple has no element types to unify (unifyTupleTypesToList), so unify ranks the three types (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go) and takes the list of strings, which the empty tuple converts to as an empty list. The spec gives an object type with all three attributes, where p keeps its type. Either way p is an unknown list of strings.
